title: Symbolic inertia startup relaxation curve
description: A symbolic family of exponential startup-relaxation curves applied to an unspecified quantity X. The proposed time constants are alternative illustrative regimes, not measured values or an established universal relaxation law.
definitions: X(t) is a quantity with the same units as its asymptotic value X_max.
X_max is the long-time limit of X(t).
t is elapsed time with t >= 0.
tau is a positive characteristic relaxation time.
equations: X(0) = 0 and lim(t -> infinity) X(t) = X_max
Proposed alternative tau regimes: approximately 10 s, 180-300 s (3-5 min), or 600-1200 s (10-20 min)
8 Hz = 8 s^-1; multiplying a mass in kg by 8 Hz gives kg s^-1, not kg
f/f_0 = (8 Hz)/(1 Hz) = 8 is dimensionless and preserves the units of X when used as a scale factor
assumptions: The exponential curve is a symbolic phenomenological model; no physical mechanism or measured system is specified.
Each listed tau range is a separate candidate regime for the same curve form, not evidence that one system exhibits all three.
The reference frequency f_0 is defined as 1 Hz when forming the dimensionless ratio f/f_0.
If X has units of kg, multiplying X by f/f_0 is dimensionally mass-preserving, while multiplying by f in Hz is not.
mechanism: No established mechanism is asserted. The exponential form and candidate time constants are symbolic proposals pending a defined system, measurement procedure and independent evidence.
predictions: For fixed X_max and tau, the normalized curve X(t)/X_max equals 1 - exp(-t/tau) for t >= 0.
A candidate tau regime can be tested only after X, X_max, the system boundary, sampling procedure and acceptance tolerance are specified.
falsification_conditions: For a specified system and predeclared X_max, tau, domain and tolerance, reproducible measurements fall outside the predicted curve by more than that tolerance.
Dimensional analysis of the declared variables shows that X(t) and X_max do not have matching units.
A mass-valued X is claimed to retain units of kg after multiplication by a dimensional frequency without a normalization or compensating unit.
confusion_guard: SYM is a symbolic model status, not empirical confirmation. The listed relaxation times are proposals, and the ratio f/f_0 is dimensionless; 8 Hz itself is not.
